import sys
import math

MOD = 1000000007

def inv(n):
    e = MOD - 2
    r = 1
    while e > 0:
        if e & 1:
            r = (r * n) % MOD
        e >>= 1
        n = (n * n) % MOD
    return r

n = int(sys.stdin.readline())
P = [list(map(int, sys.stdin.readline().split())) for _ in range(n)]

masks = []
masks2 = []

h = (n + 1) // 2
h2 = n - h
inv100 = inv(100)

for i in range(1 << n):
    c = bin(i).count('1')
    if c == h:
        masks.append(i)
    if c == h2:
        masks2.append(i)

prob = [0] * (1 << len(masks))
prob2 = [0] * (1 << len(masks2))

for i in range(1 << (n * h)):
    p = 1
    for j in range(n * h):
        x = j // n
        y = j % n
        if i & (1 << j):
            p = (p * P[x][y] * inv100) % MOD
        else:
            p = (p * (100 - P[x][y]) * inv100) % MOD
    poss = 0
    for j in range(len(masks)):
        v = []
        for k in range(n):
            if masks[j] & (1 << k):
                v.append(k)
        v_sorted = v[:]
        from itertools import permutations
        for perm in permutations(v_sorted):
            for k in range(len(perm)):
                a = k * n + perm[k]
                if not (i & (1 << a)):
                    break
            else:
                poss |= (1 << j)
                break
    prob[poss] = (prob[poss] + p) % MOD

for i in range(1 << (n * h2)):
    p = 1
    for j in range(n * h2):
        x = j // n + h
        y = j % n
        if i & (1 << j):
            p = (p * P[x][y] * inv100) % MOD
        else:
            p = (p * (100 - P[x][y]) * inv100) % MOD
    poss = 0
    for j in range(len(masks)):
        v = []
        for k in range(n):
            if not (masks[j] & (1 << k)):
                v.append(k)
        v_sorted = v[:]
        from itertools import permutations
        for perm in permutations(v_sorted):
            for k in range(len(perm)):
                a = k * n + perm[k]
                if not (i & (1 << a)):
                    break
            else:
                poss |= (1 << j)
                break
    prob2[poss] = (prob2[poss] + p) % MOD

for i in range(len(masks)):
    for j in range(1 << len(masks)):
        if j & (1 << i):
            prob2[j] = (prob2[j] + prob2[j ^ (1 << i)]) % MOD

ans = 0
full_mask = (1 << len(masks)) - 1
for i in range(1 << len(masks)):
    ans += prob[i] * prob2[full_mask ^ i]
    ans %= MOD

print((MOD + 1 - ans) % MOD)
